verdict.rationale: Cline is itself a coding agent, so it plays the MCP client role, and serving tools to other agents as an official MCP server is a different product role. The evidence only shows client-side MCP use (using external MCP servers, managing MCP servers). Its ACP mode lets other clients host Cline as their coding agent, but that is a different protocol, not an MCP server endpoint.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
